followupFindings.failure: C3 witness-directory exec resets the Durable Object after empty attach reported ready
followupFindings.rawError: the witness directory was not created: A call to blockConcurrencyWhile() in a Durable Object waited for too long. The call was canceled and the Durable Object was reset.
followupFindings.productCall: packages/devbox/src/devbox.ts:2133 exec -> ensureReady -> super.exec; readiness can first enter resolveAdoption -> adoptOrTurnOver -> readBootId -> rawExec -> super.exec
followupFindings.confirmed: The first witness-directory operation did not return successfully. C3 baseline, overwrite and changed-file restore never ran. The prior initial state reported running:true, ready:true, restoration:attached and bootId 2a58e3b8-67b3-46c5-ac0f-1b43e74a45e0.
followupFindings.blockAttribution: Unmeasured: the captured exception contains no block identity or pending-await stack. The three direct Devbox blocks at lines 640, 1625 and 1706 perform storage operations only, not container exec. The SDK adds its own blocks, including node_modules/@cloudflare/containers/dist/lib/container.js:641 awaiting state.setHealthy then onStart.
followupFindings.candidateNotVerdict: The SDK onStart block can reach devbox.ts:953 adoptOrTurnOver -> readBootId -> rawExec while RPC initialization is in progress. The installed startContainerForRPC healthy-state guard is intended to prevent that reentry. No recorded trace proves this guard was bypassed or that this block timed out; a self-deadlock is a hypothesis, not a confirmed cause.
followupFindings.discriminatingMeasurement: On a separate lifecycle ticket, tag each Devbox and SDK block entry/exit and the RPC start/boot-id exec awaits, preserve the tags durably, then reproduce the first post-empty-attach witness mkdir. The last unsettled block and its last await identify the owner without inferring it from the generic reset string.

followupFindings.failure: Sparse publication used whole-upper fallback, so the block-layer counter fixture cannot measure it
followupFindings.confirmed: The 2-GiB sparse baseline and edited checkpoints committed, and the container was destroyed and restored with a new boot id. Restored chain rev 2 has base and delta but no deltaFormat:chunked. No block-lower-stats.json exists; the counter read aborts the remaining byte-verification step.
followupFindings.sourceBoundary: snapshot-chain.ts:stageChunkedDelta returns null after logging a probe/hash/staging fallback reason; commitChain publishes the whole upper and leaves deltaFormat absent. This run did not capture that console reason.
